# 💳 gws Drive Upload

💳 Requires a paid Google Workspace account for the gws CLI — no free tier. Curated by Skill Harbor — the Drive-upload module of the gws CLI: upload a file with automatic metadata (`gws drive +upload <file>`), with options for parent folder and target filename. Distinct from the already-listed gws-drive: this is the focused upload subcommand, same format as the other gws subcommand listings. By @googleworkspace, listed here with credit to its creator. Honest caveats: it documents CLI usage — the gws binary must be installed and authenticated; large uploads and shared-drive targets follow the flags, not defaults; the shared auth/security rules live in a separate gws-shared skill the agent must read first. Skill Harbor never reviews the code, review it yourself before use.
